'''Mountain Eagles'''  are [[charmable]] birds which can be found in the snowy mountains of the [[Far Shiverpeaks]].

==Locations==
*[[Core]]
**[[The Battle Isles]]
***{{NPC location|Zaishen Menagerie Grounds}} (levels 5, 12, 15, and 20, depending on unlock progress)
*[[Eye of the North]]
**[[Far Shiverpeaks]]
***{{NPC location|Ice Cliff Chasms}} (west of [[Eye of the North (outpost)|Eye of the North]], near [[Nidbjorg]], and south of the exit to [[Norrhart Domains]])
***{{NPC location|Drakkar Lake}}
***{{NPC location|Varajar Fells}}

==Notes==
*This creature uses the same model as other flying birds in the game, but has a different [[skin]].
*Hearty, Playful, Elder, and Aggressive Mountain Eagles deal [[piercing damage]], while Dire and unevolved Mountain Eagles deal [[slashing damage]].
*[[Zaishen_Menagerie_Grounds/Service_costs|Unlocking cost]]: 1{{zsilver}} plus 100{{gold}} or 1,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] ''(Common, Tyria)''

==Trivia==
*Despite the name, the appearance bears more likeness to the [[w:harpy eagle|harpy eagle]].
